args.body: the document exists: taxon Cupriavidus necator, placed in Cupriavidus < Burkholderiaceae < Burkholderiales < Betaproteobacteria. The clade table reaches outside the animals as of this run -- it ran from Metazoa downward before, so every bacterium, archaeon, fungus and plant was unplaceable, and unplaceable propagates: no clade scope can be decided, no reference set can say whether it is covered.
